steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Open the Events list as the buyer.
Verify the list rendered with the Create Event control and no error.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Create the requested Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one available QA vendor.
Publish the configured event.
Verify the buyer reached the published project page.
Open the separate supplier portal session for the invited QA vendor.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the first mandatory RFQ clause is displayed to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory RFQ clause is displayed to the vendor.
Accept the displayed terms as part of submission and quote 100 for the line.
Verify the vendor's RFQ bid was submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer sees the terms-acceptance confirmation.
Open the vendor session again to inspect the Technical stage separately.
Open the Technical response round.
Verify the RFQ clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Verify the second RFQ clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
